name: pg_resp
abstract: A Redis-protocol (RESP2) cache server inside a PostgreSQL background worker
description: pg_resp runs a RESP2-speaking TCP server inside a PostgreSQL background worker, so redis-cli and every existing Redis client library can talk to your database directly. It is in-process: not a proxy, not a sidecar, and not a layer that translates each operation into SQL. Strings, TTLs, CLOCK-LRU eviction and a hard memory cap, plus a resp.* SQL surface and a resp.evict trigger function that makes cache invalidation a property of the schema rather than of application discipline. Ephemeral by design.
